$description: RocketRide color tokens. Source of truth for all color values. Light and dark.
$status: Light theme and logo values are as-shipped and verified. The interaction, status, and dark groups are marked $status: proposed and await design review. See _unresolved before treating this file as complete.
$contrast: Every ratio quoted in a description is computed, not estimated. Re-run the checker described in MIGRATION.md after any edit.

brand.description: Primary brand color. Sampled from the shipping cloud.rocketride.ai hero. This is the logo red, promoted to brand in v2.0 - see the resolved logo decision in README.md.

accent.description: Same as brand. Kept as a separate token so accent can diverge later without a find and replace.

secondary.description: 5.74:1 on surface.bg, 5.17:1 on surface.widget. Passes AA on every light surface in this file.

default.description: Decorative divider only. 1.37:1 on surface.bg, far below the 3:1 required for a meaningful UI boundary. Do not use it for input or control outlines - use border.strong.

strong.description: Interactive component boundaries: inputs, checkboxes, control outlines. 3.36:1 on surface.bg and 3.03:1 on surface.widget, so it clears the 3:1 non-text minimum on both.

button.$description: The primary button is ink-filled with an offset accent block. It is NOT accent-filled, and that is deliberate: white on brand.accent is only 3.74:1, which fails the 4.5:1 a normal-size label needs. Ink fill gives 18.74:1. The accent survives as a hard offset block behind the button, which carries no text and so has no contrast obligation. This is the construction the shipping hero already uses.

primaryAccentBlock.description: Hard-edged block offset down-left behind the button at 30% of the label type size. No rounded corners, no soft shadow, no text on it.

primaryAccentBlockOffset.description: Offset as a fraction of the label type size, applied both down and left.

interaction.$description: Applies to links and accent-filled controls. The primary button uses the button group instead.

accentSubtle.description: Tinted background for accent-flavored callouts. text.primary on it is 15.15:1.

disabledFg.description: 2.54:1 on disabledBg. Below AA by design - WCAG exempts disabled controls. Never rely on the disabled color alone to convey state.

focusRing.description: 3.74:1 on surface.bg, clearing the 3:1 non-text minimum.

focusRingHalo.description: Inner halo drawn between the control and the ring, so one focus construction reads on both light and dark surfaces. Flips to dark.focusRingHalo in dark theme.

status.$description: The brand accent IS red, so error must be a visibly different red and must never be the only signal - always pair status with an icon or a text label. status.error against brand.accent measures only 1.77:1, which is why iconography is mandatory rather than encouraged. warning is deliberately pushed to a dark amber, well clear of the retired orange #f7901f and of brand.accent, for the same reason. Horizon Blue #41b6e6 from the superseded palette is far too light to serve as info text and is not used.

illustration.$description: Applies to generated art, not to UI chrome. Both values were sampled off the shipping hero, not carried over from the draft token file.

ground.description: Flat background in minimalist-stipple assets. Warmer than surface.bg on purpose so art reads as art, not as a UI panel that failed to load. brand.accent on it is 3.19:1 - large text only.

inkDark.description: Dark theme inverts the art: the ground value becomes the ink. Assets must be INVERTED, not recolored - recoloring the ink to light while leaving the ground light produces an unreadable asset.

logo.$description: Reconciled with brand in v2.0. The red is no longer an exception - it IS the brand color. Abyss Blue #1e1a34 from the superseded palette has been retired out of the SVGs in favor of logo.ink.

red.description: Was a standalone logo-only exception. Now an alias, because brand.brand was set to this value.

ink.description: #12111a. Replaces Abyss Blue #1e1a34 in rocketride-logo-color.svg and rocketride-icon-color.svg.

offWhite.description: Used in the white logo variants

dark.$description: Dark theme. Derived, not sampled - no dark reference design exists yet, so every value here is a proposal for review. The page ground is the brand's own ink, so dark mode is built from the brand rather than from neutral grey.

borderStrong.description: 3.97:1 on dark.bg and 3.34:1 on dark.widget, clearing the 3:1 non-text minimum on both.

accent.description: brand.accent lightened 10 percent for dark surfaces. The pure brand red reaches only 4.22:1 on dark.widget, which fails AA for normal text; this variant reaches 4.62:1 there and 5.49:1 on dark.bg. The alternative was darkening dark.widget until the pure red passed, which cost the surface hierarchy its visible separation. Documented rather than hidden - see _unresolved.

buttonPrimaryBg.description: Dark theme inverts the button construction: accent fill with an ink label, 5.49:1. Red performs better on dark than on light, so the ink-fill workaround the light theme needs is unnecessary here.

_deprecated.$description: Retired values. Recorded so nobody reintroduces them from an old deck, an old SVG, or the palette PNG in deprecated/.

items.name: brand orange
items.reason: Was brand.brand in the 0.1.0 draft. Never shipped. Measures 2.00:1 on illustration.ground, so it cannot serve as an accent word at any size, and the product was already shipping #f93822 in that role. Replaced by brand.brand.

items.name: Abyss Blue
items.reason: From the superseded palette in deprecated/Palette.png. Was the wordmark and rocket color in the logo SVGs, which made the logo the last artifact in the repo built on the old system. Replaced by logo.ink.

items.name: draft illustration ink
items.reason: Draft value, never sampled. The shipping hero uses #12111a. Replaced by illustration.ink.

items.name: draft illustration ground
items.reason: Draft value, never sampled. The shipping hero uses #eeede7. Replaced by illustration.ground.

items.name: Deep Graphite
items.reason: From the superseded palette. Used nowhere in the repo.

items.name: Night Amethyst
items.reason: From the superseded palette. Used nowhere in the repo.

items.name: Imperial Indigo
items.reason: From the superseded palette. Used nowhere in the repo.

items.reason: From the superseded palette. Used nowhere in the repo, and too light to serve as status.info text.

_unresolved.$description: Known gaps. Fill these before anyone treats this file as complete.
items: Text tertiary and muted levels. The superseded sheet had four text levels, this file documents two.
The interaction, status, and dark groups are all marked $status: proposed. Contrast is verified but the hues have had no design review.

illustration.ink and illustration.ground describe the intended system, not the delivered assets. The 20 committed minimalist-stipple tiles are near-black on a non-uniform near-white plate sampling #f1f1f1 to #ffffff, not #12111a on #eeede7. Compositing them onto illustration.ground needs an alpha knockout, not a background swap. See styles/minimalist-stipple/STYLE.md.
dark.accent is not brand.accent. That divergence is a contrast necessity, not a design choice, and should be reviewed alongside the dark theme.
Typography, spacing, radius, and elevation are entirely absent. This file is color only.
Whether the trademark mark on the wordmark should be TM or R, and whether it belongs on the icon variants too. Not answerable from this repo.
